artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a half-length sitting portrait. The individual is seated, slightly turned to the side. Their facial features are slightly visible, possibly due to photo quality. They have short or closely cropped hair, and wear clothing with a pattern and a white collar. Their right hand rests on their lap with a white cuff visible. The image has a vintage frame with a gold and red border. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her upper body visible. She is posed with her elbow resting on a table draped with a patterned cloth, her hand touching her face, and adorned with jewelry on her fingers. Her facial features are distinct, with a broad forehead and soft expression, accentuated by her hair parted in the middle and styled smoothly to frame her face. She is dressed in a dark gown with a high neckline, white lace collar, cuffs of matching lace, and a long chain necklace. The background is plain, and the image is presented in an oval frame with a gold-colored border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a decorative wooden chair. He is captured from head to knees, sitting upright with his left arm resting on his lap, holding a walking stick. His right arm appears to be propped on an adjacent table. The man has a composed expression with defined facial features, including a slender face and a slightly pointed chin. His hair is styled with a neat side parting, appearing short and groomed. He is dressed in a formal attire consisting of a dark jacket over a high-collared shirt, with a visible tie, and light-colored trousers. The table next to him is covered with an ornate patterned cloth. The background is a plain backdrop with a vintage, sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Girls
artworks.description: The image shows two girls from the waist up, sitting closely together. The older girl is positioned directly next to the younger girl, and both are facing slightly towards the camera. The older girl has long, dark hair styled in braids, framing her face with a middle part, and her facial expression is neutral. She wears a dark dress with a high collar and plaid decoration near the neck. The younger girl wears her hair parted in the middle and down to her ears, and she also has a neutral expression. Her dress is dark with short sleeves and a white lace or embroidered collar. Their hands are folded in their laps, and they appear to be sitting on a piece of furniture like a chair. They are framed within an ornate, oval-shaped gilded frame with floral and leaf patterns. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.description: The image shows a child sitting on a chair. The child is facing forward, with hands clasped in their lap. They have a serious expression, curly hair, and wear a dark dress with a light collar, light socks, and dark shoes. The chair has a decorative back, and the background is plain. The image is bordered by a golden frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: This image shows a seated woman from the waist up, facing the camera. She has dark hair styled neatly with a decorative headpiece framing her face. The woman wears a dark, high-necked dress with full sleeves and a lace collar fastened with a brooch. There is a small book on a table to her left, and the background is neutral. The photo is framed in ornate gold with a floral design.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in historical formal attire with a composed expression. She is holding an object in one hand and standing next to a wooden table. The scene is captured in a gold-trimmed frame.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Semele
artworks.medium: pen and ink with gray wash on laid paper, partially laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas Martin in memory of his parents, Vernon Paul and Jean Webster Martin
artworks.description: This is an image showing two mythological figures in a dramatic interaction. One figure is crowned and holds a lightning bolt, approaching another reclining figure. Both figures are surrounded by smoke and clouds, with ornate details and a curtain in the background. The ink and wash technique is used, creating strong contrasts and bold outlines.

artworks.title: La Guerre est déclarée (War is Declared)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas Martin in memory of his parents, Vernon Paul and Jean Webster Martin
artworks.description: The image depicts a street demonstration. In the center, a figure holds a flag aloft while surrounded by a crowd also holding flags and signs. The crowd appears to be moving energetically, with a sense of unity and purpose. The artist uses strong lines, contrasting black and white colors, and rich details in the clothing. The style suggests deliberate strokes reminiscent of traditional print-making techniques.

artworks.title: Fête Champêtre with a  Seesaw (La Bascule)
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with gray wash and traces of graphite on laid paper

artworks.title: Fête Champêtre with Game of Hot Cockles (La Main Chaude)
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and gray and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper

artworks.title: The Naming of the Virgin Mary
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in a historical or religious setting. In the center, a bearded man in a long robe and bishop's mitre holds an infant, looking upwards. To his left is another person in a long robe. In the lower right corner, there are kneeling figures including a praying woman, a woman holding an infant, and a man with his hand on his chest. A standing woman holds a child and gestures towards the center. The sky above has clouds, cherubs, and angels, some holding an object with "MARIA" inscribed on it. The background features architectural elements and figures in draped clothing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl from the waist up. She is standing with her left hand resting on a table draped with a patterned cloth. Her facial features are soft, with a smooth complexion, and her expression is neutral. She has straight, dark hair that is neatly parted down the middle and pulled back tightly, allowing her ears to be visible. She is wearing a long-sleeved, buttoned-up dress with thick ruffled accents on the sleeves and shoulders, and a lighter skirt peeks out from underneath the dark fabric. The surrounding environment is simple, with the ornate tablecloth adding some texture to the otherwise plain background.

artworks.title: Spectacle in Honor of the Grand Dukes of Russia in the Theater of San Benedetto, 1782
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of a theater interior. The drawing shows a grand theater with multiple tiers of balconies filled with spectators in period clothing. The theater is richly decorated with intricate patterns, artwork, cherubs, and elaborate mouldings on the walls and ceiling. A chandelier hangs from the ceiling, and there are stairs leading up to the stage, which is busy with activity. The atmosphere conveys grandeur and sophistication, suggesting a significant event or performance.

artworks.title: Mary Stuart, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up. The person is facing forward with their head slightly tilted downward and eyes closed. They have a serene expression with delicate bone structure, soft eyebrows, and a distinctive jawline. The person has dark hair styled neatly under a decorative crown and a headpiece that comes to a point at the center of their forehead. They are wearing an ornate garment with a high, lace-trimmed collar. The background is a textured oval of shaded graphite that accentuates the figure.

artworks.title: Bust of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and upper body, facing to the right. The person is positioned in a left-facing profile, with their head slightly turned. They have well-defined facial features with a prominent nose and chin, and their hair is styled in an elaborate updo that is neatly gathered at the back of the head. The person is seen wearing a garment that appears to drape over their shoulders, and they wear a necklace with a small pendant visible. The background is a textured surface composed of pencil or etching lines, creating a sense of depth against the otherwise plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Bust of a Bearded Warrior
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person turned slightly to the right, with a profile view. The person is wearing an ornate helmet with a plume and decorative patterns. The facial features include a strong jawline and prominent nose, and the neck has detailed muscular contours. The individual is dressed in armor with detailed designs, including shoulder guards and a chest piece adorned with decorative motifs. The background consists of diagonal hatching, emphasizing the subject without any discernible objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Bust of a Bearded Man
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a bearded man. He is depicted from the waist up, in a three-quarter view, gazing upward and to the left. His chin is slightly raised, and he has a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. He has a well-defined, curly beard and wavy hair falling around his forehead and ears. He is covered in a loose cloth over his left shoulder, exposing most of his chest. The background consists of a sketch-like pattern of cross-hatched lines, creating depth and contrast with the outlined figure. The sketch is framed by a plain, grainy texture.

artworks.title: Louis-Philippe, Duc d'Orléans, and His Son, Louis-Phillipe Joseph, Duc de Chartres
artworks.dimensions:
image: 26.7 × 17.9 cm (10 1/2 × 7 1/16 in.)
sheet: 27.8 × 18.9 cm (10 15/16 × 7 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One man is seated in an armchair, leaning back with his hands on his lap. He has wavy hair, a slightly prominent nose, and a double chin. He is wearing an ornate coat with a star on the chest, knee-length breeches, and stockings. The other man is standing slightly behind him, with his hands on the seated man's shoulder. He has delicate features, shoulder-length wavy hair, and wears an embroidered coat, breeches, and stockings. The setting is grand, with a high-arched door, decorative carvings, heavy curtains, and a small table with curved legs.

artworks.title: Frontispiece with Scorpion
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an image of a scorpion with text above it. At the bottom, there is a detailed depiction of a scorpion. The scorpion's body is emphasized with sharp lines and its tail is poised. Above the scorpion, there is a signature or inscription that resembles a name, accompanied by the term "ACQYEFORTI." The image presents a contrast between the detailed scorpion and the abstracted surroundings.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.artist: Pierre Fatoure and Gabriel Lejeune, after Caravaggio
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann, by Exchange
artworks.description: Printed with black ink on light tan paper, this horizontal etching and engraving shows a young man with long hair, Jesus, sitting at a table with one hand lifted. Two people sitting at the table react, and a third stands on the far side, near Jesus’s shoulder. The front corner of the table is near and parallel to the lower right corner of the print. The table is covered with a cloth and holds a bowl of fruit, a roasted game bird, vessels, and a chunk of bread. At the center of the composition, Jesus holds up his right hand, to our left, and hovers his left hand over the table. His eyes are cast down or closed, and he leans slightly to our right. The two men at the table have beards and short, wavy hair. The man to our right holds both arms straight out to his sides as he looks toward Jesus’s hands. A shell is affixed to the front of his cloak. The other man wears tattered robes and sits on our side of the table in a U-shaped wooden chair. He grips the arms of the chair with both hands and juts his head forward, also staring at Jesus’s hands. The fourth person stands and looks down at Jesus in profile, mouth slightly parted. The background is shaded with parallel and overlapping hatching. Inscriptions are printed across the lower margin with “M. age dicarauage In. P. Fatoure: G. giovane f.” to the lower left, “Firmat et accendit diuino Lumine Corda, Cristus quem nostuns augustum frangere panem” at the center, and “Luc 24” in the lower right.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements and sculptures in a landscape. A large sarcophagus with human figure reliefs is depicted, next to a decorative capital. A scroll with a cityscape and text, including buildings, is seen on the left. In the background, there is foliage and a stone archway. Textures and shadows are used to create depth in the drawing.

artworks.title: Esther before Ahasuerus
artworks.artist: Charles-Paul-Jean-Baptiste de Bourgevin Vialart de Saint-Morys, after Johann Carl Loth
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in gray-brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and organic shapes forming an abstract scene of figures surrounding a central figure wearing a crown. The figures resemble classical statues with drapery-like textures and dynamic poses. The composition suggests movement and interaction, with the central figure gesturing towards the others. The overlapping lines and forms convey a bustling atmosphere, reminiscent of a gathering or event.

artworks.title: Saint John Preaching
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures witnessing a dramatic scene in the heavens. The image shows several figures gathered together, some gesturing upwards towards the sky, where a dynamic scene unfolds with clouds and winged beings. The huddled figures below are dressed in flowing garments, and their expressions vary from awe to fear.
